title: Randomized crossover evaluation of ReproCheck-assisted artifact review
design: Within-participant randomized crossover with four matched case pairs; each participant reviews eight cases, one manual and one assisted case per pair, counterbalanced by a deterministic participant-code arm.
primary_endpoint: Correct clean-versus-defect decisions per participant under assisted versus manual review
exclusion_rules: discussion with another participant before response freeze

analysis_plan.missing_data: exclude the incomplete participant before unblinding; do not impute

scientific_boundary: The prepared cases are controlled and author-designed. Even a completed study estimates assistance on this task and participant pool, not universal publication-review performance. No packet may be distributed before the responsible school or fair committee determines and records the required SRC/IRB approval and consent process.
